description: A classic residential front entry photographed at standing eye-level with a normal lens in a centered symmetrical composition, capturing the full front door surround in autumn. The house exterior is white painted brick, crisp and clean. The entry features a prominent arched surround in painted smooth plaster or limestone — a full semicircular arch with a fanlighted transom window above the double doors. The double entry doors are painted in a warm greige-taupe tone with large glass panels, matte black hardware, and flanked by narrow sidelights. Louvered plantation shutters in a warm taupe-brown flank the windows on both sides of the entry, adding traditional architecture character. The multi-pane windows beside the entry have matte black frames. Three wide concrete entry steps with bullnose profiles ascend to the threshold from a concrete walkway. Flanking the steps, neatly rounded ball-shaped boxwood topiaries grow in the landscaped bed. A large terracotta pot holds a lush Boston fern, and a small black pot holds a compact shrub. Autumn foliage is visible — a mature tree at upper left shows brilliant orange and amber fall leaves, and scattered fallen leaves rest on the concrete steps. A black metal mailbox is mounted to the brick left of the door. Warm amber light glows from both flanking wall fixtures, washing the white brick on either side of the arch with honeyed halos. The overall mood is refined, welcoming autumn domesticity.
